issues.title: Cambodia did not initiate 2025 clashes with Thailand, Hun Manet says (VIDEO)
issues.title_en: Cambodia did not initiate 2025 clashes with Thailand, Hun Manet says (VIDEO)
issues.summary: Prime Minister Hun Manet told the Francophonie Summit that Cambodia did not initiate either of the two rounds of armed clashes with Thailand in 2025, adding that no borders had been altered through the use of armed force or the creation of faits accomplis.
